items.title_zh: An early breakdown in the polar vortex is threatening already depleted gas stocks
items.summary: 未调用大模型，以下为原文关键信息摘录：An unprecedented early breakdown of the stratospheric polar vortex and a record-breaking El Niño event has put energy traders on alert this winter, with analysts warning the weather and climate phenomena could have an outsized impact on Europe.；Meteorologists are currently observing a record early breakdown of the polar vortex, a large-scale circulation of strong winds that typically keeps extremely cold air over the North Pole.；Changes in the strength and shape of the polar vortex can influence weather patterns much lower down in the atmosphere, potentially bringing in colder weather to parts of Europe and North America.
important_points: An unprecedented early breakdown of the stratospheric polar vortex and a record-breaking El Niño event has put energy traders on alert this winter, with analysts warning the weather and climate phenomena could have an outsized impact on Europe.
Meteorologists are currently observing a record early breakdown of the polar vortex, a large-scale circulation of strong winds that typically keeps extremely cold air over the North Pole.
Changes in the strength and shape of the polar vortex can influence weather patterns much lower down in the atmosphere, potentially bringing in colder weather to parts of Europe and North America.

items.title: Why Anthropic's blockbuster IPO couldn't escape the stock market correction
items.title_zh: Why Anthropic's blockbuster IPO couldn't escape the stock market correction
items.summary: 未调用大模型，以下为原文关键信息摘录：No one can say the Anthropic initial public offering wasn't a success for the company.；Deal size and pricing were signs of what IPO experts say was insatiable demand for "ANT" shares.；But what came within a day is something that investors better get used to: anxiety in the stock market about valuations being assigned to artificial intelligence revenue and business models that should keep Anthropic shares volatile in the period ahead.
important_points: No one can say the Anthropic initial public offering wasn't a success for the company.
Deal size and pricing were signs of what IPO experts say was insatiable demand for "ANT" shares.

But what came within a day is something that investors better get used to: anxiety in the stock market about valuations being assigned to artificial intelligence revenue and business models that should keep Anthropic shares volatile in the period ahead.
